Reports, delivered to your account

Every report is uploaded against your Patient ID and visible only to you after login — nobody else can open it. Most lab reports are ready the same day; imaging reports follow the report time shown with each test.

New here? Create your free patient account

Registration takes a minute. You get a unique Patient ID (for example P-2026-0142) that stays yours for every future visit, test and report at MediCare. Login works with your Patient ID or your mobile number, plus your password.

Find my records

Login is required to search and view records. Enter your Patient ID (for example P-2026-0142) or your registered mobile number to find your appointments, test bookings and reports. Records open only from your own account — searching someone else's ID or number will never show their information.
